title: Ugali with Sukuma Wiki and Beef Stew
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a heavy-bottomed pot, then gradually stir in maize meal until thick and firm.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 10 minutes, then mold and set aside.
In a separate pan, sauté onions and tomatoes in oil, add beef cubes, and cook until tender.
In another pan, quickly sauté onions and the chopped collard greens for 5 minutes.
Serve the beef and greens alongside hot ugali.

title: Avocado and Egg Toast
ingredients: Salt, black pepper, and chili flakes
instructions: Toast the bread slices until golden brown.
Mash the ripe avocado with a pinch of salt and black pepper, then spread evenly over the toast.
Fry or poach the eggs to your preference.
Place an egg on top of each avocado toast and garnish with chili flakes.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions, then drain.
Heat oil in a wok or large pan, add minced garlic and chicken strips, and cook until browned.
Add sliced bell peppers and carrots, stirring frequently until tender-crisp.
Toss in the cooked noodles and pour soy sauce over the mixture.
Stir well until completely heated through and serve.

title: Creamy Lentil Soup (Ndengu Soup)
instructions: Heat oil in a pot and sauté onions, garlic, and carrots until soft.
Add diced tomatoes and cumin powder, cooking until a thick paste forms.
Stir in the pre-boiled green lentils and vegetable broth.
Simmer on medium-low heat for 15 minutes to allow flavors to blend, then serve warm.

title: Tropical Fruit Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Blend the frozen banana, mango chunks, and coconut milk in a blender until smooth and thick.
Pour the smoothie mixture into a bowl.
Top with a handful of granola and a sprinkle of chia seeds before serving.
